verdict.rationale: PostHog's signup wizard takes an explicit `--region us` flag, its cloud runs in separate US and EU clusters, and the MCP server stores session state in the region you connect to and routes accounts to the correct data region. A first-party MIT Docker Compose self-host option offers full control over where data lives. Missing for 10: dedicated data-residency documentation (region list, what data stays in-region, region migration), and independent or hands-on corroboration of region selection.
